title: 8 Day Eastern US and Canada Tour from New York
includes: Mandatory attractions (see itinerary), if "Tour w/Partial Ticket" options selected
Hotel for seven nights with breakfast.
Professional transportations by passenger van or a full-sized bus & commercial insurance.
Optional attractions (see itinerary), if "All Inclusive" options selected
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Age & Safety: Customers under 18 must be accompanied by an adult. Pregnant travelers may join if 24 weeks or less by the trip's end.
Room details: Rooms have either two Full/Double beds or one King/Queen, subject to availability at check-in. Maximum occupancy is four travelers per room.
Tickets & charges: Pre-purchased tickets and city passes are not accepted; purchase through us or the guide. Group reservations recommended.
Room selection / booking guidelines: Parties over four, or those wanting separate rooms, should make separate bookings. To stay on the same bus, share all confirmation numbers once booked.
Leaving the group: Notify the guide in advance and sign a departure form; no refund for unused portions.
Gifts & refunds: Itinerary gifts may change due to weather or other factors; no refund for such changes.
Closed attractions: If a stop is closed, an alternative or exterior view may be substituted; opening hours and capacity may change.
Booking details: Ensure name, contact, and flight info are accurate; errors are at the traveler's cost. A reachable phone number is required.

Luggage & border crossing: Luggage is inspected at borders and must be claimed before crossing; unclaimed luggage can't cross. Declare dutiable items. Operator isn't responsible for luggage at borders; travelers denied entry arrange their own transport.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Two countries, eight days, one seamless journey — New York City, Philadelphia, Washington D.C., Niagara Falls, Toronto, Montreal, Quebec City, and Boston in a single cross-border trip.
Stand where the U.S. was born, from Philadelphia's Independence Hall to the founding documents in Washington's National Archives and Boston's revolutionary "firsts." Feel the thunder of Niagara Falls lit up at night, ride to the top of One World Observatory, and cruise past the Statue of Liberty. Then cross into Canada for Toronto's skyline, the charm of Old Montreal, and the walled, French-flavored streets of Quebec City — a UNESCO gem that feels like Paris.
A fixed bilingual guide travels with you throughout, handling every border crossing so the days flow smoothly, with comfortable hotels each night and a flexible mix of optional experiences to shape the trip around what you love most.
